fields.summary: .kit/reports/check/20260718-2139-thin-triggers-smoketest.md (T5 cold-verify evidence, thin-triggers phase) was written with run_id:none and never registered via zharness check record — check record --run-id is mandatory, but simple-mode/ad-hoc check invocations produce no run row to link. Surfaced as an audit stale_pointer/missing_key violation (check id 01KXTTNGQR385ECNPV7KP060Q9 has no matching row in the checks table). The underlying claim (cold agent successfully ran check full on a trivial diff) is still true per the markdown content; only the DB registration is missing. Suggest either check record accepting an optional/absent run-id for ad-hoc checks, or the check playbook explicitly noting simple-mode checks are markdown-only and skip harness registration.
